explication: JiraCLI is an interactive terminal client for Jira. Users invoke commands to search and navigate issues, inspect boards and projects, or perform issue, epic, sprint, and release operations; results are rendered in the terminal, with optional browser navigation. The map follows the documented command-to-Jira workflow and includes configuration, query, rendering, and authentication layers. Several command implementations are unsampled, so links among individual domain operations are not asserted; their capabilities are represented by the command paths in the tree.
